+     setSelectedAddons((prev) =&gt; {
+       if (prev.includes(addonId)) {
+         return prev.filter((id) =&gt; id !== addonId);
+       } else {
+         // Initialize discount state for new addon
+         if (!addonDiscounts[addonId]) {
+           setAddonDiscounts(prevDiscounts =&gt; ({
+             ...prevDiscounts,
+             [addonId]: { discountType: "none", discountValue: 0 }
+           }));
+         }
+         return [...prev, addonId];
+       }
+     });
+   };
+ 
+   const updateAddonDiscount = (addonId: string, discountType: "none" | "fixed" | "percentage", discountValue: number) =&gt; {
+     setAddonDiscounts(prev =&gt; ({
+       ...prev,
+       [addonId]: { discountType, discountValue }
+     }));
+   };
+ 
+   const calculateAddonDiscountedPrice = (addon: typeof availableAddons[0]) =&gt; {
+     const discount = addonDiscounts[addon.id];
+     if (!discount || discount.discountType === "none" || discount.discountValue === 0) {
+       return addon.price;
+     }
+     if (discount.discountType === "fixed") {
+       return Math.max(0, addon.price - discount.discountValue);
+     }
+     if (discount.discountType === "percentage") {
+       return addon.price * (1 - discount.discountValue / 100);
+     }
+     return addon.price;
    };

## Summary of Changes

### 1. ✅ Added "One-time Charges" Section (Read-only)
- New collapsible section showing charges like Implementation Fee, Platform Setup Fee, Training & Onboarding
- Displays status (Paid/Pending), paid date, and amount
- Shows total one-time charges
- Includes a note: "One-time charges are managed in Chargebee and displayed here for reference only"

### 2. ✅ Added Discounts for Add-ons
- Add-ons now support discounts similar to licenses
- In the overview, add-ons show discount badges (e.g., "$20 off") with original price crossed out
- In the Edit Subscription modal, each selected add-on has discount controls:
  - Discount type dropdown: None, Fixed ($), Percentage (%)
  - Discount value input
  - Shows savings amount

### 3. ✅ Removed "Trial End Date" Field
- Removed from the Plan Information section in the overview
- Removed from the Edit Subscription modal

### 4. ✅ Removed "Invoices" Tab
- Removed the Invoices tab completely since Finance team accesses them from Chargebee
- Only "Overview" tab remains

### 5. ✅ Added "Quarterly" Option to Billing Cycle
- Added Quarterly option between Monthly and Annually
- Works in both the overview display and Edit Subscription modal

+     setOneTimeChargeDiscounts(prev =&gt; ({
+       ...prev,
+       [chargeId]: { discountType, discountValue }

+   };
+ 
+   const calculateOneTimeChargeDiscountedPrice = (charge: OneTimeChargeWithDiscount) =&gt; {
+     const discount = oneTimeChargeDiscounts[charge.id];
+     if (!discount || discount.discountType === "none" || discount.discountValue === 0) {
+       return charge.amount;
+     }
+     if (discount.discountType === "fixed") {
+       return Math.max(0, charge.amount - discount.discountValue);
+     }
+     if (discount.discountType === "percentage") {
+       return charge.amount * (1 - discount.discountValue / 100);
+     }
+     return charge.amount;
+   };

## Summary

Added one-time charges with discount controls to the Edit Subscription modal.

### Changes made

1. Updated `Subscription.tsx`:
   - Added `discountType` and `discountValue` to one-time charges in mock data
   - Updated `editModalData` to include one-time charges with discounts
   - Updated the overview table to show a Discount column
   - Updated totals to use discounted prices

2. Updated `EditSubscriptionModal.tsx`:
   - Added `OneTimeChargeWithDiscount` interface
   - Added state for one-time charge discounts
   - Added `updateOneTimeChargeDiscount` function
   - Added `calculateOneTimeChargeDiscountedPrice` function
   - Added a One-time Charges section in the modal with:
     - Read-only charge information (name, amount)
     - Discount controls (None, Fixed, Percentage)
     - Visual indicators for discounts (original price crossed out, discounted price in green)
     - Change tracking for discount modifications
   - Updated changes detection to track one-time charge discount changes

### Features

- One-time charges are displayed in the Edit Subscription modal
- Each charge shows discount controls (None, Fixed $, Percentage %)
- Discounts are applied and displayed with visual feedback
- Changes are tracked and shown in the confirmation dialog
- The overview page shows discounts on one-time charges

The one-time charges section appears after the Add-ons section in the Edit Subscription modal, with discount controls similar to licenses and add-ons. Charges themselves remain read-only (managed in Chargebee), but discounts can be applied to reduce amounts.

Slack message draft:

---

**Hey team! 👋**

Just pushed updates to the Subscription feature in Internal Admin:

**✨ New Features:**
• **One-time Charges Section** — Read-only section showing one-time charges (Implementation Fee, Platform Setup Fee, Training & Onboarding) synced from Chargebee
• **Discount Support** — Apply discounts to:
  - Add-ons (fixed $ or percentage %)
  - One-time charges (fixed $ or percentage %)
  - Licenses (already existed, now consistent)
• **Quarterly Billing Cycle** — Added Quarterly option alongside Monthly and Annually

**🗑️ Removed:**
• Trial End Date field (out of scope)
• Invoices tab (Finance uses Chargebee directly)

**🎨 UI Improvements:**
• Removed tab navigation header (only Overview remains)
• Discounts show original price crossed out and discounted price in green
• Better organization with collapsible sections

All changes are live and ready for testing. Let me know if you have questions or feedback. 🚀

Fixed the TypeScript error and pushed the change.

**The Issue:**
`currentSubscription.addons` is an array of `AddonWithDiscount` objects (with `id`, `discountType`, `discountValue`), not strings. Using `.includes(a.id)` on an array of objects doesn't work.

**The Fix:**
Changed from:
```typescript
.filter((a) => currentSubscription.addons.includes(a.id))
```

To:
```typescript
.filter((a) => currentSubscription.addons.some(addon => addon.id === a.id))
```

This checks if any addon in the array has a matching ID. The fix has been committed and pushed. The build should now pass.
